description: Discover, compare, and bundle open agent skills (SKILL.md files) for AI coding agents. Includes the Skill Finder MCP server and REST API as agent skills.
name: skill-finder

skills.description: Keyword search over the open agent-skills catalogue, ranked by install count. REST: GET /api/public/v1/skills?q=&agent=&limit=. MCP: search_skills.
skills.name: search-skills

skills.description: Full details and install command for one skill. REST: GET /api/public/v1/skills/{id} (URL-encode the id). MCP: get_skill.
skills.name: get-skill

skills.description: Curated skills for a specific AI agent (claude, cursor, chatgpt, copilot, ...). REST: GET /api/public/v1/skills/agent/{agent}. MCP: list_agents.
skills.name: list-agent-skills
